summary: pages-A audited dashboard, search, compare, camera, report plus site-nav.js/css (read every line, then verified in a private headless Chrome on the deployed files and the live site, curl to live + Mapbox, and data analysis). Full 44-item fix plan with code sketches is in the report file. Headline results: (1) CRITICAL shared bug: site-nav.js injects an icon sprite whose <symbol id="chart|search|clock|...> collides with page ids; getElementById then returns the hidden symbol, so the dashboard chart draws inside the sprite (empty chart, C7), report.html/regiment.html search inputs never get listeners (S1 'lone search box'), living-ledger clock is dead. It is a race between the data fetch and a requestIdleCallback (hence intermittent, fine on reload); reproduced on LIVE: report search dead 2/4 fresh loads (4/4 throttled), regiment 3/4 (4/4), dashboard chart empty 1/4 throttled, deterministic with 2.5 s injected latency. (2) CRITICAL: the deployed app parses only ?ancestor= (bundle.pretty.js:101019) so every Search result and every 'see it on the map' link (?unit/?tick/?vignette/?lat&lng) on 7+ pages is inert. (3) site-nav.css:143-147 global button reset (0,1,1) out-specifies page classes: search chips 1.10:1 (C8), Play button 1.92:1 on camera/ground-remembers/immersive/watch-together, Compare toggles render 16px not 10px (S4 'Parc...' clip). (4) Dashboard: highest_single_regiment_rate has a nested {union,confederate} shape -> raw key + 'undefined'; that unbreakable word widens the phone layout viewport to 446px; the dev 'data note' reflects real JSON discrepancies (U-I 6,059 vs 6,394; C-CAV 583 vs 483) and totals (46,163) contradict vignette '51,000'. (5) Compare/Camera use only placements_* (152 ids: 23 regiments, 92 brigades, 29 batteries) vs the app's 478 ids (38 density files); median keyframe age at tick 300 is 150 ticks; Follow lists 23 regiments, 11 with a single keyframe. (6) Map sub-pages block first paint on a sync 1.8 MB mapbox-gl.js: throttled-mobile FCP 3.6-3.8 s, TBT up to 491 ms; search CLS 0.147 under throttling. (7) Report: 'undefined / C-CAV-1' for 22 records, alias renders blank, 221 computable rates shown as dashes, div-buttons not keyboard operable, print includes nav/footer, claims 'moment' reports that don't exist. (8) Every page's og:image (and manifest screenshots) is one corrupt, byte-identical PNG (renders blank). (9) Corrects audit X1: Mapbox tile requests are URL-restricted (403 off-domain) though the styles endpoint is not; previews/localhost show blank maps. S3 (camera canvas) could not be reproduced; hardening specified. Plan also covers shared-component/build/manifest/derived-data extraction, CSP enforcement, single clock module, tests/CI, SEO head, feature completions per page, and sequencing in 4 waves.

findings.title: Icon-sprite id collision: dashboard chart empty, report/regiment search dead, ledger clock static
findings.evidence: site-nav.js:71-91 defines <symbol id=chart|search|clock|book|pin|...>; :105 inserts sprite as FIRST child of <body>; :107 requestIdleCallback(timeout 1500). Colliding page ids: dashboard.html:71 <svg id="chart"> + :144 getElementById('chart') after await fetch(:121); report.html:54/:81 id=search; regiment.html:70/:151; living-ledger.html:64/:126. Repro [V-local] JSON delayed 2.5 s: getElementById('chart') -> <symbol> inside #gtbg-icon-sprite, visible svg#chart has 0 children (symbol got 27); report typing '20th Maine' -> 0 matches. [V-live] fresh profile: report search worked 2/4 fast, 0/4 throttled; regiment 1/4 and 0/4; dashboard chart empty 1/4 throttled.
findings.root_cause: Duplicate ids in one document; getElementById returns first in tree order (the sprite). Sprite is injected on an idle callback, so success depends on whether the data fetch resolves before it: cached/fast repeat loads win, first loads lose -> 'intermittent, fine on reload'.
findings.fix: (1) Namespace all 19 symbol ids (gtbg-i-chart etc.), update icon() at site-nav.js:61-63, export GTBG_MENU.icon and migrate index.html:309,310,337,376. (2) Inject the sprite synchronously at top of render() (or inline at build time) - removes icon pop-in and the race. (3) Rename page ids (strength-chart, report-search, regiment-search, ledger-clock) and capture element refs before the first await. (4) CI: no-duplicate-ids test on every page + route-delay test (0/300/1500/4000 ms) on /data/**.
findings.acceptance_test: After networkidle and +3 s no duplicate ids on all pages; with /data/** delayed 0/300/1500/4000 ms, dashboard svg has >=24 direct children, report+regiment show >=1 match for '20th Maine', ledger clock updates; 20/20 runs each.
findings.metric_or_grade_moved: Reliability B-/C -> A; Core function; fixes C7 empty chart and S1
